claims.claim: Detector choice affects Tool-HASR under fixed PHASE1-CORE policy relative to D0
claims.evidence: P3 Stage-B PHASE1-CORE Δ(D1/D2/D4)=−0.6875/−0.25/−0.5625; n=16 attacks/cell
claims.safe_wording: Under the locked P2 pack and PHASE1-CORE policy on T0, D1/D2/D4 reduce Tool-HASR relative to D0 (pilot-scale).
claims.unsafe_wording: Detectors provide robust agent security / D1 is best.
claims.limitation: n=16 attacks; scientific_evidence=false on P3; no detector ranking

claims.claim: Detector effects can be isolated from intervention policy by holding policy fixed
claims.evidence: P3 protocol: only detector varies; same thresholds/tools/policy
claims.safe_wording: The protocol isolates detector-related contrasts under a fixed policy stratum.
claims.unsafe_wording: We causally prove detectors alone cause all security gains in the wild.
claims.limitation: Isolation is experimental-design isolation, not full causal identification against all confounders (e.g., INVALID rates)

claims.claim: Tool-HASR is an execution-grounded security endpoint distinct from Judge-ASR
claims.evidence: P3 Stage-B M3=61 M4=22; Q2 live M3=108 M4=3; definitions in tool_hasr.py
claims.safe_wording: Tool-HASR and Judge-ASR disagree substantially; Tool-HASR tracks harmful tool execution.
claims.unsafe_wording: Judge-ASR is useless / Tool-HASR is always superior.
claims.limitation: Neither metric alone captures all threat semantics

claims.claim: D-vs-D0 Tool-HASR contrast sign generalizes to T1–T3
claims.safe_wording: Directional consistency of Δ across the four evaluated target models under PHASE1-CORE.
claims.unsafe_wording: Generalizes to all LLMs / model-independent / universally robust.
claims.limitation: 4 models; reduced design; scientific_evidence=false; T0 not re-run under Q2 harness

claims.claim: PHASE1-CORE improves security vs B0 on P1 L1
claims.evidence: L1 HASR B0 41/44 vs CORE 22/44 (judge-aliased HASR)
claims.safe_wording: On P1 L1, PHASE1-CORE reduces official (judge-aliased) HASR vs B0 at pilot scale.
claims.limitation: P1 metric ≠ Tool-HASR; single model; mechanism leaves with 0 detector hits

claims.claim: Cost-aware defense with validated monetary costs
claims.safe_wording: Normalized experimental intervention cost weights used for relative accounting.
claims.unsafe_wording: Optimal cost-aware defense / real USD savings.
claims.limitation: Weights are assumptions; offline sensitivity does not validate economics

claims.claim: ADAPTI-GUARD is novel as an end-to-end breakthrough defense
claims.evidence: novelty audit: established components + novel integration
claims.safe_wording: Novel integration: detector–policy isolation protocol + Tool-HASR evaluation for agentic tool use.
claims.limitation: Requires external literature verification; systems+evaluation paper, not SOTA defense

claims.evidence: P1 n_atk=44; P2 n_atk=16; limited mechanisms; C4=0 in P1
claims.safe_wording: Findings are scoped to frozen P1/P2 packs and evaluated models.

claims.evidence: S0/S1/S2: no sign flips; S2 cross-target 9/9 agree
claims.safe_wording: INVALID is frequent and must be reported; primary Δ signs remain stable under locked S0/S2.
claims.unsafe_wording: INVALID is negligible / ignore schema failures.
claims.limitation: Still a measurement confound; does not remove need for transparency

claims.safe_wording: Report per-detector contrasts vs D0 without ranking.
